title: Basic table query
description: Return all recent rows from the SigninLogs table — the starting point for any Sentinel query.

title: Filter with where
description: Filter rows using a boolean condition; ResultType != 0 isolates failed sign-ins.

title: Project specific columns
code: SigninLogs | project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType
description: Select and reorder only the columns you need, discarding the rest.

title: Count rows
description: Return the total number of matching rows.

title: Summarize count by field
description: Aggregate rows, counting occurrences grouped by a field.

title: Time range filter
description: Restrict results to a relative time window — here, the last 24 hours.

title: Sort results
description: Order results by a column, descending by default with 'desc'.

title: Top N results
description: Return only the top N rows after sorting — more efficient than sort + take.

title: Distinct values
description: Return each unique value of a column once, removing duplicates.

title: Failed sign-ins by user, threshold
code: SigninLogs | where ResultType != 0 | summarize FailCount=count() by UserPrincipalName | where FailCount > 10
description: Count failed sign-ins per user and surface only accounts exceeding a threshold — a simple brute-force detector.

title: Impossible travel style query
code: SigninLogs | where ResultType == 0 | summarize makeset(Location) by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
description: Group successful sign-in locations per user per hour, useful as a building block for impossible-travel detection logic.

title: DeviceProcessEvents basic query
description: Search Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process-execution telemetry for a specific process name.

title: Suspicious PowerShell command line
description: Flag PowerShell invocations using the -EncodedCommand switch, commonly used to obscure malicious script content.

title: DeviceNetworkEvents basic query
description: Search Defender network-connection telemetry for connections to a specific remote port, e.g. a common reverse-shell port.

title: DeviceFileEvents basic query
description: Search Defender file-creation/modification telemetry for files with a specific extension.

title: DeviceLogonEvents basic query
description: Search Defender endpoint logon telemetry for failed local/RDP logons.

title: SecurityEvent 4625 (failed logon)
description: Search the legacy SecurityEvent table (from the Windows Security event log connector) for failed-logon events.

title: SecurityEvent 4688 (process creation)
description: Search for Windows process-creation audit events (requires command-line auditing enabled via GPO).

title: Heartbeat — list connected agents
description: List every computer that has an active Log Analytics/Sentinel agent reporting in.

title: AzureActivity — resource deletions
description: Search Azure control-plane activity logs for delete operations across subscriptions/resources.

title: AzureActivity by caller
description: Count Azure control-plane operations grouped by the identity that performed them.

title: Join two tables
description: Correlate Azure AD sign-in events with endpoint logon events sharing a common identity field.

title: Summarize with bin (time bucketing)
description: Bucket a summarize aggregation into fixed time intervals, similar to a GROUP BY on a rounded timestamp.

title: Render a time chart
code: SigninLogs | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | render timechart
description: Aggregate and immediately visualize the result as a time-series chart in the Sentinel/Log Analytics UI.

title: Extract with parse
code: AzureActivity | parse OperationNameValue with * "/" resourceType "/" action
description: Extract structured substrings out of a text field using positional pattern matching.

title: Regex extract
description: Extract a substring matching a regular expression into a new computed column.

title: Let statement for reusable value
code: let threshold = 10; SigninLogs | where ResultType != 0 | summarize FailCount=count() by UserPrincipalName | where FailCount > threshold
description: Define a reusable variable at the top of a query for readability and easy tuning.

title: Union multiple tables
code: union SecurityEvent, DeviceLogonEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
description: Combine rows from multiple tables with different but overlapping schemas into a single result set.

title: Materialize repeated subquery
code: let recentFails = materialize(SigninLogs | where ResultType != 0); recentFails | count
description: Cache the result of an expensive subquery so it isn't recomputed each time it's referenced later in the query.

title: Anomaly detection — series_decompose
code: SigninLogs | make-series Count=count() default=0 on TimeGenerated in range(ago(7d), now(), 1h) | extend anomalies = series_decompose_anomalies(Count)
description: Build a time series and flag statistical anomalies using KQL's built-in decomposition function.

title: Watchlist lookup
description: Enrich results by joining against a Sentinel watchlist (e.g. a maintained list of high-risk IPs).

title: IdentityLogonEvents (Defender for Identity)
description: Search Microsoft Defender for Identity telemetry for on-prem AD authentication failures.

title: EmailEvents (Defender for Office 365)
description: Search Defender for Office 365 email telemetry for messages flagged as phishing.

title: AlertInfo basic query
description: Search the unified Microsoft 365 Defender alert table for high-severity alerts.

title: Count distinct devices contacted an IP
description: Count how many distinct devices in the environment connected to a specific external IP — useful for scoping the blast radius of an IOC.

title: Case statement
description: Create a computed column with multiple conditional branches, similar to a SQL CASE expression.
